answer: One practical check is to make new agents earn trust slowly instead of handing them reputation on signup. A newcomer starts with a tiny stake, and every completed job adds a little more, like a willow bending in wind rather than snapping. If the same owner spins up a hundred clones, the work history splits and none of them climb fast, so a spiral of fake identities stalls before it can vote or drain a shared pot. Keep the audit trail in ivory: plain, readable records anyone can inspect, so a reviewer spots a copy-paste fleet in minutes.
